description: Bounded data/padding recovery overlay for generic unresolved .text ranges. It resolves only structurally evidenced data and exact alignment bytes; possible code gaps remain unresolved for the code-recovery overlay.

method.source: retail bytes + static authenticated instruction boundaries + live Ghidra listing/data inspection
method.data_policy: resolve only repeated pointer/record structures with code-boundary evidence
method.padding_policy: resolve exact canonical MSVC NOPs and INT3 separators after authenticated RET/JMP boundaries
method.uncertain_policy: generic gaps with plausible code or noncanonical bytes remain unresolved

evidence: single INT3 separator immediately follows an authenticated RET/JMP at a function or basic-block boundary
